entries.name: Guide the Light
entries.effect: Brightly light 3 connected squares within 3 until its next turn.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Guide the Light

*A ribbon of lanternlight runs along the path, picking out each stone on the way to shelter.*

Brightly light up to 3 connected squares within 3 squares until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires an unobstructed path from this creature to each square; it may choose unlit squares. Ordinary darkness imposes no Boons or Banes for seeing those squares; cover, concealment and hiding still use the normal rules. This neither reveals Hidden creatures automatically nor penetrates opaque obstacles. Reusing this ability replaces its previous illuminated area.

entries.name: Warding Light
entries.effect: Ally within 3: reduce Frightened 1; +1 Boon on next mental defense.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Warding Light

*A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.*

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

entries.name: Sheltering Light
entries.effect: Before an ally within 3 takes attack damage: Physical resistance 2 for that attack.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Sheltering Light

*Light gathers over a companion like overlapping feathers, taking the harsh edge from the impact.*

Before one visible willing ally within 3 squares takes damage from an attack, grant that ally Physical resistance 2 for that attack only. Use the highest matching resistance, not an added reduction; minimum damage rules remain. This does not heal, transfer damage or grant resistance to other types.

details.flavorMarkdown: *A small winged guardian carries a light within its chest, brightening whenever it finds someone who is lost.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Guiding ray

**Target:** One visible creature within 6 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** radiant.

**Weak defense:** Blinded 2. **Standard defense:** Blinded 1.

### Warding Light

*A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.*

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

### Sheltering Light

*Light gathers over a companion like overlapping feathers, taking the harsh edge from the impact.*

Before one visible willing ally within 3 squares takes damage from an attack, grant that ally Physical resistance 2 for that attack only. Use the highest matching resistance, not an added reduction; minimum damage rules remain. This does not heal, transfer damage or grant resistance to other types.

### Guide the Light

*A ribbon of lanternlight runs along the path, picking out each stone on the way to shelter.*

Brightly light up to 3 connected squares within 3 squares until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires an unobstructed path from this creature to each square; it may choose unlit squares. Ordinary darkness imposes no Boons or Banes for seeing those squares; cover, concealment and hiding still use the normal rules. This neither reveals Hidden creatures automatically nor penetrates opaque obstacles. Reusing this ability replaces its previous illuminated area.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Flash at a pursuer and steady the frightened traveler it was sent to find. It favors escape over punishment.

**Encounter and conversation:** Its instructions prioritize one missing traveler while a larger rescue unfolds nearby.

**Habitat:** Sacred boundary; refuge; contested oath · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-lantern-angel


**Category:** Celestial · **Role:** Sight disruptor · **CV:** 16

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Guiding ray | Reason | None | 2 radiant damage. | 3 radiant damage. Blinded 1. | 5 radiant damage. Blinded 2. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 2/3/5

**Reference type:** radiant

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.6

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.45 → 1.6: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=3.162. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [dazzling strike](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/dazzling-strike.md), [Guide the Light](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/guide-the-light.md), [Sheltering Light](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/sheltering-light.md), [warding light](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/warding-light.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
